markdown:
[seal: County of Louisa Virginia] **COUNTY OF LOUISA** **Finance Department** REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL # ES-21-04 ADDENDUM # 1 - **Date**: April 29, 2021
- **Title**: Property and Casualty Insurance Services for Louisa County Fire and EMS NOTICE: Due to difficulty retrieving information, an additional addendum will be issued next week. **Please change the final Due Date to May 11, 2021.** Attached is an updated vehicle list as of April 2021. - **Question**: Can you advise what the current premium is? - **Answer**: [blank]
CoverageAnnual Premium
Property$ 20,734.00
Crime$ 1,310.00
General Liability$ 7,199.00
Auto Liability$ 16,826.00
Auto Physical Damage$ 55,777.00
Portable Equipment$ 6,427.00
Management Liability$1,302.00
Excess Liability$4,055.00
Pollution Liability/Fuel Tanks$855.00
Total:$114,485.00
- **Question**: Please provide the year built, approximate square footage & construction type for the following buildings:
Loc. 3/3 MVFD (628 Louisa Avenue) - Stage ($40,000 requested building limit)
Loc. 3/4 MVFD (628 Louisa Avenue) – Pavilion ($15,000 requested building limit) - **Answer**: **The stage is 40' x 24' and made of wood. The pavilion is 80' x 20' and made of wood.** - **Question**: Is the General Liability policy in this RFP designed to cover the volunteer exposure only?
- **Answer**: **Yes.** - **Question**: Please confirm if 1 hard copy & 1 electronic copy is requested for the submission.
- **Answer**: **Please submit one (1) electronic copy and four (4) paper copies.** ATTACHMENTS: 1 END OF ADDENDUM
